feedback_target_id_check.name: feedback_target_id_check
feedback_target_id_check.value: ("feedback"."target_type" = 'general' and "feedback"."target_id" is null) or ("feedback"."target_type" != 'general' and "feedback"."target_id" is not null)

knowledge_claim_sources_reference_check.name: knowledge_claim_sources_reference_check
knowledge_claim_sources_reference_check.value: "knowledge_claim_sources"."source_id" is not null or "knowledge_claim_sources"."document_id" is not null

knowledge_claims_valid_range_check.name: knowledge_claims_valid_range_check
knowledge_claims_valid_range_check.value: "knowledge_claims"."valid_until" is null or "knowledge_claims"."valid_from" is null or "knowledge_claims"."valid_until" >= "knowledge_claims"."valid_from"

coordinate_observations_review_check.name: coordinate_observations_review_check
coordinate_observations_review_check.value: ("place_coordinate_observations"."review_status" = 'pending' and "place_coordinate_observations"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("place_coordinate_observations"."review_status" != 'pending' and "place_coordinate_observations"."reviewed_at" is not null)

places_coordinate_group_check.name: places_coordinate_group_check
places_coordinate_group_check.value: ("places"."longitude" is null and "places"."latitude" is null and "places"."coordinate_system" is null) or ("places"."longitude" is not null and "places"."latitude" is not null and "places"."coordinate_system" is not null)

places_verified_coordinate_check.name: places_verified_coordinate_check
places_verified_coordinate_check.value: "places"."coordinate_verification" != 'verified' or ("places"."longitude" is not null and "places"."latitude" is not null and "places"."coordinate_system" is not null)

places_missing_coordinate_check.name: places_missing_coordinate_check
places_missing_coordinate_check.value: "places"."coordinate_verification" != 'missing' or ("places"."longitude" is null and "places"."latitude" is null and "places"."coordinate_system" is null)

procedures_schedule_check.name: procedures_schedule_check
procedures_schedule_check.value: "procedures"."starts_at" is null or "procedures"."ends_at" is null or "procedures"."ends_at" >= "procedures"."starts_at"

procedures_validity_check.name: procedures_validity_check
procedures_validity_check.value: "procedures"."valid_from" is null or "procedures"."valid_until" is null or "procedures"."valid_until" >= "procedures"."valid_from"
